##### Project general facts

Akala Residences by Arada is a wellness-led development of two elegant towers in a prime central setting, with facades that combine natural stone and polished metal to balance nature and modern technology. The towers share four basement parking levels, a ground floor and a three-level podium of premium amenities. One tower is dedicated to private residences, while the other houses hotel suites with hospitality services available to residents. The collection offers one- to six-bedroom apartments, including penthouses with private terraces.

Wellness defines every part of daily life. Residents enjoy a spa with treatment rooms, a high-performance fitness club with a pool and recovery zone, yoga, aerial yoga and meditation studios, a sauna, a steam room and an infinity pool, along with adult and children's pools. A cinema, a residents' lounge, a children's club and play area, multi-purpose sports courts and a meditation garden complete the offer, supported by a personal wellness concierge, butler, valet parking and round-the-clock security.

Interiors feature spacious layouts with panoramic glazing and a design centred on wellbeing. Every residence includes a kitchen with an island, spa-inspired bathrooms and generous walk-in wardrobes, while acoustic zoning, advanced air purification and smart home controls for climate, humidity and lighting create a calm and healthy environment. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Za'abeel is a prestigious central district set between the Dubai International Financial Centre and Downtown Dubai, known for Zabeel Park, the Dubai Frame and its calm, green surroundings. The area combines landmark residential towers with easy access to world-class business, cultural and dining destinations, offering a refined address at the very centre of the city's financial and lifestyle life.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Financial Centre Road connect residents with the wider city. Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and the Dubai International Financial Centre are a short drive away, along with Dubai Opera, City Walk and Dubai Healthcare City. Dubai International Airport is within comfortable reach, while Al Maktoum International Airport, schools and hospitals are accessible across the city's main road network.

Za'abeel is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the most central residential addresses in Dubai. Proximity to the main financial district attracts executives, professionals and high-net-worth families, supporting demand for premium homes. Branded hotel services and a wellness-led concept add strong appeal for both owner-occupiers and investors, underpinning resilient rental demand and long-term value in a supply-constrained location.
